cycle: Standard Time per Piece — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
shift: Machine Shift Time (Hours) = Machine OFF Time − Machine ON Time
idealQty: Ideal Quantity = Machine Shift Time × 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece — not rounded down, as on the sheet.
rejectedQty: Rejected QTY = TOTAL QTY − OK QTY, so OK + Rejected = TOTAL. The breakdown shows how it splits across Blow Holes, Crack/Damage, Threading, TAP Broken and Other.
pctOk: % OK Quantity = OK Quantity ÷ (OK Quantity + Rejected Quantity)
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total Idle Time (Min) = Setup Time + B.D. (Breakdown) + Lunch / Tea / Washroom + Other
effective: Effective Machine Run Time (hours) = TOTAL QTY × Standard Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece run counts, rejected ones too.
unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Effective Machine Run Time × 60 − Total Idle Time, for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the operator's whole date).
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − (Setup + B.D. + Other) ÷ 60) — every stoppage except Lunch / Tea, for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the operator's whole date).
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch / Tea ÷ 60), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the operator's whole date).
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and setup time = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Machine Shift Time − Total Idle Time; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch / Tea. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Standard Time per Piece × TOTAL QTY ÷ Operating Time, for this entry. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review — usually a wrong time per piece, quantity or idle time.
quality: Quality = OK QTY ÷ TOTAL QTY, for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance, Quality or any of its OEE figures (the Productivity figures, on a worker sheet) is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
rejectSplitTotal: The reason columns added up — always equal to Rejected QTY.
idealQtyPerHour: Ideal Quantity/Hours = 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece
